names.addNote: Made for your goal: Asking shop staff for help, from a quick question to a longer one.

questions.text: Do you often avoid social situations or activities?
Do social situations often leave you afraid or embarrassed?

start.help: Avoiding social situations, or feeling afraid or embarrassed in them, is common, and a doctor or a psychologist can help with it: talking treatments for it are well tested. This path is practice, not treatment, and it can sit beside help.

check.name: A monthly private check

questions.text: In the last month, has anyone you are dating made you afraid, or tried to control where you go, whom you see or what you spend?
Has anything you did toward them worried you afterwards: a raised voice, pressure, checking up on them?
Is there a doubt about this relationship you keep setting aside?

check.help: If someone’s behaviour frightens you, or your own worries you, you do not have to sort it out alone. The National Domestic Violence Hotline answers day and night: 1-800-799-7233, or text START to 88788, or thehotline.org. In danger now, call 911.
